table.name: TLGNR_TIMEZONE_BS
table.description: A TimeZone entity which is composed of an Olsen TZ Id and an associated country

column.name: TIMEZONE_CD
column.description: PK. A valid id given from the list https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones. For example, Europe/Paris or Europe/Moscow would be a valid id.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
